question: Should OpenClaw implement this timeline as a first-class core surface now, wait for the metadata-audit and subagent-lifecycle foundations, or decline/scope it to existing Activity and trajectory tools?
rationale: The request adds public observability/export surfaces over sensitive agent/session/tool data and overlaps open foundation issues, so code inspection cannot choose the persistence owner, retention policy, redaction boundary, or API shape safely.

options.title: Design the foundation first
options.body: Settle the metadata-only audit and subagent lifecycle contracts, then layer timeline CLI/chat/TUI/export views on that single source of truth.

options.title: Ship an ephemeral-only timeline
options.body: Limit the first implementation to live, non-durable observation and explicitly defer JSON export and historical queries.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces only
options.body: Decline a new core timeline for now and rely on Activity, sessions tail, trajectory export, and plugin-specific observability.

recommendation.title: Design the foundation first
recommendation.body: Settle the metadata-only audit and subagent lifecycle contracts, then layer timeline CLI/chat/TUI/export views on that single source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the adjacent metadata-audit direction and appears in recent shared-state and lifecycle history that would shape the product/security contract.
